summary: Madison reports its adopted one-year moratorium prevents zoning approvals and, consequently, building and occupancy permits for new principal-use data or telecommunications centers above 10,000 square feet. The stated end is January 24, 2027 unless replaced sooner by a new ordinance. The city’s October 2026 zoning framework is a draft.
authority: City of Madison, Department of Planning and Community and Economic Development
locator: Temporary Data Center Moratorium: What Does the Moratorium Do?; Frequently Asked Questions
evidence: over 10,000 square feet in floor area
